title: Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack contains an out-of-bounds read in mg_timegm() that…
description: Cesanta Mongoose versions 7.22 up to but not including 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack have an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the mg_timegm() function. This flaw allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service by crashing the process during TLS handshake when presented with a crafted X.509 certificate containing invalid month values in the certificate validity period.
